findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: the migration-inventory classification vocabulary promised by CHK-004/CHK-007 is not documented. packages/main/src/core/provider-process-registry.ts:395-400 defines ProviderExecutionSurfaceStatus with five values (managed | admission_only | adapter_only | readiness_probe | legacy_unmanaged), and packages/main/src/tasks/provider-execution-inventory-contract.ts:45 asserts no PROVIDER_EXECUTION_SURFACES row uses 'legacy_unmanaged'. The checklist names documenting 'legacy_unmanaged' three times (CHK-004 adversarial:0, CHK-007 context, CHK-007 edge:2) and plan.md:81 repeats 'Document ... legacy_unmanaged vs admission_managed'. However docs/requirements/decisions/managed-cross-provider-cli-execution.md:114-116 documents only `adapter_only` plus a sentence that readiness/version probes are 'classified separately'; grep for 'legacy_unmanaged' and 'admission_managed' across docs/host-run-usage.md, docs/requirements/decisions/managed-cross-provider-cli-execution.md, docs/CLI.md and CLAUDE.md returns zero hits. No doc names the classification set, the legacy_unmanaged boundary, or where an auditor reads the inventory (PROVIDER_EXECUTION_SURFACES is never referenced by any doc). Severity medium rather than high: the shipped code contract is strictly stronger than the documentation, so no doc claims a capability the code lacks; the gap is an undelivered documentation promise, not a misleading behavioral description.
